title: Isolate shared brick penetration failure
requires: CUDA or D3D12; second adapter confirmation before qualification
scope: Reduce the shared approximately 7 mm penetration failure against the existing 2 mm gate.
acceptance: The reproduction distinguishes contact generation, solver response and fixture problems.
Retain the failing gate and propose separate bounded corrective work; no tolerance relaxation.
evidence: PASS: python -m unittest conformance.v1.tests.test_quality; 16 tests; rigid-brick-penetration-v1 SHA-256 59f42d2fc20434552f053aaea3df08c9a12165763e9c0d33d7bcfc693d462659; rejects altered fixture settings, invalid frames, incomplete execution, nonfinite/negative depth and penetration above 0.002 m.

PASS: retained Windows GTX 1080 report records unchanged oracle/scene and original CUDA 0.00702056 m at frame 101 plus D3D12 0.00721844 m at frame 102; corrected F5-10 measurements are 0.000205278 m on both. docs/QUALIFICATION.md separates fixture, contact-generation and solver-response causes; no tolerance, iteration-budget or backend-specific physics change.
